label: D2: second consecutive rewarded a2->S1 rare transition (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the agent chose a2 and landed rarely in S1 (99% of mass). Within that it needs the previous trial to have been the same a2->S1 rare transition and to have been rewarded (prev_reward=1 seen at this D1). So it marks a repeated, rewarded rare transition, the case where a model-based agent should switch. It also only fires late in episodes (never before ep_trial 50, rising after 60), and in low-value steps (value < 7.5). It never fires at D1/GO, after a1, on S2, or on common transitions. Activations with no prior a2->S1 trial in the window are mostly on the first window trial, where prev_* is unknown. False positives look the same as hits, so the leftover miss is threshold/magnitude, possibly tied to episode time. All variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used. Dev F1 0.78 (0.74 with ep_trial>=50).
